regime_context: The TSX thematic detector shows a broad, non-dominant leadership structure (9 of 16 themes eligible, one_narrative=false, absorption low) with Base Metals & Copper narrowly ahead of Oil & Gas Producers/Silver & Gold. This is an attention/focus lens only; the one validated edge is the absolute-trend gate as risk control, so calls stay lean on direction and heavier on what would falsify them.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Oil & Gas Producers overtakes Base Metals & Copper as confirmed leader: the condition to retire this watch is XEG.TO closing above XBM.TO's return over a rolling 20-day window on two consecutive weekly closes.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Highest durability_bar (0.64) among eligible leaders plus broadest eligible breadth (0.643) and a positive score (1.55) suggest the trend gate is most supportive for energy — the one leg with validated drawdown-avoidance value. Momentum rank is not being read as a forecast, only as focus concentration coincident with the strongest trend-health leg.
theses.dissent: The leading Base Metals theme carries a higher score, and energy's crowded_z of 0.96 is near the caution zone; a broad oil pullback would hit this name hard regardless of its internal trend health.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its own 60-day moving average while XBM.TO closes above its own before 2026-11-05.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Current leader by rank (1.74) with moderate durability (0.51) and half-decent breadth (0.556), not crowded (0.8). Leaning with the confirmed leader but without treating rank as alpha — modest trend-gate support only. The r10 is negative (-0.045) and hurst_tag is mean-revert, which tempers conviction.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag and negative 10-day return suggest the leadership may already be stalling; if copper gives back a risk-on premium, this theme has the most room to fall from the top of the leaderboard.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO underperforms XEG.TO by 5% cumulatively before 2026-11-05.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Eligible under the trend gate but crowded (crowding_z 1.22, crowded=true) and carrying a negative score (-0.205). Crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade; with no direction edge from rank and a crowding flag, the disciplined posture is avoid while the flag remains.
evidence: durability_bar 0.66 (trend healthy but not a return edge)
theses.dissent: Technology has the second-highest durability_bar among all 16 themes (0.66) and strong breadth (0.6); avoiding it could leave upside on the table if a sustained tech bid ignites.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO's crowding_z falls below 0.8 AND its score turns positive before 2026-11-05.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
